name: slider-25
description: Investment risk profile slider with discrete labelled levels and an allocation summary.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Slider } from "@workspace/ui/components/slider" const profiles = [ { label: "Conservative", stocks: 20 }, { label: "Cautious", stocks: 40 }, { label: "Balanced", stocks: 60 }, { label: "Growth", stocks: 80 }, { label: "Aggressive", stocks: 95 }, ] export default function RiskToleranceSlider() { const [level, setLevel] = React.useState([2]) const profile = profiles[level[0]!]! return (
Risk tolerance {profile.label}
setLevel(value as number[])} max={profiles.length - 1} />
{profile.stocks}% stocks {100 - profile.stocks}% bonds
) }
